name: GhostTextarea
description: Themed wrapper around headless GhostTextarea. Same behavioral props plus size. Importing it loads the default stylesheet and scopes styles to this instance. Hand-written until GHO-13 generates manifests.

props.name: modelValue
props.description: Controlled value, forwarded to the unstyled GhostTextarea.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial uncontrolled value, forwarded to the unstyled GhostTextarea.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Forwards native disabled semantics to the unstyled GhostTextarea.

props.name: readonly
props.description: Forwards native readonly semantics to the unstyled GhostTextarea.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Forwards invalid semantics to the unstyled GhostTextarea.

props.name: required
props.description: Forwards native required to the unstyled GhostTextarea.

props.name: rows
props.description: Native rows, forwarded to the unstyled GhostTextarea.

props.name: maxRows
props.description: Auto-resize ceiling, forwarded to the unstyled GhostTextarea.

props.name: autoResize
props.description: Forwards auto-resize to the unstyled GhostTextarea.

props.name: size
props.description: Control size. The default omits data-size so CSS can treat a missing hook as md.

models.description: v-model binding forwarded to the unstyled GhostTextarea.

exposed.name: element
exposed.description: The native textarea after mount; null before mount and after unmount. Delegates to the unstyled GhostTextarea.

exposed.name: focus
exposed.description: Focuses the native textarea when it is mounted and enabled. Delegates to the unstyled GhostTextarea.

exposed.name: blur
exposed.description: Removes focus from the native textarea when it is mounted. Delegates to the unstyled GhostTextarea.

parts.name: root
parts.description: The textarea element inside the display:contents themed scope.

states.name: disabled
states.description: Unavailable appearance from native disabled and data-state.

states.name: invalid
states.description: Danger border from aria-invalid, including when readonly.

cssProperties.name: --ghost-control-size-md-padding-block
cssProperties.description: Default block padding. sm/lg swap the matching control size tokens.

cssProperties.name: --ghost-type-line-normal
cssProperties.description: Field line height, also used as the auto-resize fallback for line-height: normal.

keyboard.Enter: Insert a newline. Does not submit the form.
keyboard.Tab: Leave the field. Native tab order.
